title: Probo
tagline: An AI art generation app unique to each identity, built on Worldcoin, MetaMask, and QuickNode.
description: Welcome to Probo, where the beauty of your iris unlocks a gateway to an enchanting fusion of reality and imagination. By leveraging Worldcoin's authentication, our WebApp creates personalized landscapes that are as unique as you are. Powered by AI, our breathtaking artwork captures the essence of your world. Each creation is exclusively yours, forever. You can even mint these generated landscapes as NFTs on the Ethereum mainnet, verifying and displaying them through your MetaMask wallet. Come see your world.
how_its_made: We leveraged Worldcoin's unique human authenticator built on zero-knowledge proofs to verify the user and receive a unique personal hash for each user. We used this hash to seed a random generator and generate a corresponding noisy image (an image with randomly generated pixels). Next, we used a stable diffusion AI model we trained on an extensive landscape image data set to remove noise over time from the image and eventually generate a beautiful (imaginary) slice of the world. Since the noisy image used as a source for the model is unique to the user, the image is as unique to the user as their iris. The user can choose to mint the artwork to their Web3 wallet, where they are able to share it as a unique part of their identity.
